note: v4 final setup, Unity side (Stage F, 2026-11-13, Nusrat; Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 13, declared before it was built). Read by TrialRunnerV4 only when TrialPlayV4 -finalSetting NAME is given. The numbers of a final (task, final seed, runs per setting, timeout, success radius) are NOT here: they are read from robot_vision/configs/v4/final_plan.json (Anisha's file, read only). No final run and no freeze are made by this file.
done_file_note: Written into a final session folder after its last run; one per setting, never overwritten. Not FINAL_DONE.json: Python's final_guard_v4.markers scans every folder under the output root for that name and would take a Unity file for the setting's evaluation. The guard also refuses a setting with Python's FINAL_RUN_DONE.json (key setting).
settings_note: EXPERIMENTS A/B (2026-11-14, Avatar/Config/experiments_ab.md section 7, declared before it was built; Nusrat): the final settings of the new study, which REPLACES the four v4 Task 2 finals (kept below under superseded_settings, never run). One setting per experiment, A2 with the right and the left turn, B2 with the right turn; each names its final experiment config (sessions/final_ab_<setting>.json: experiment, side, the test looks sunbox_m_shirt_plaid and sunbox_f_shirt_plaid, the test clips, the Python control file). workers_config is the base trial_workers_v4.json (an experiment reads only its data_splits path and the commander / forward commands). TrialPlayV4 -finalSetting <setting>; the Python server must run with --final-setting <setting> and the control file of the experiment config (Anisha adds the settings to final_plan.json and bridge/server.py FINAL_CONTROL; until then the guard refuses every one).
superseded_settings_note: SUPERSEDED on 2026-11-14 by the experiments A/B (experiments_ab.md section 7); kept for the record, refused by the guard (FinalGuardV4: 'superseded'). Their note, as written on 2026-11-13: B7 = plan (b), decided by Nusrat on 2026-11-13 in Anisha's absence and confirmed by Anisha on 2026-11-13 (upgrade_design.md section 13; AUDIT.md section 15): every final uses the test look sunbox_f2 with the test clips, the only plan her unchanged guard_run accepts for all four settings. zoom_on and zoom_off differ only on the Python side (bridge.server --final-setting with control_zoom_on.json or control_zoom_off.json). zoom_on_repeat (named unseen_look until 2026-11-13) is a REPEAT of zoom_on (same configs; a repeatability measure); the unseen-look question is answered by comparing the finals with the development results. In bystanders every person wears sunbox_f2, so the commander is told apart only by behaviour.
freeze_files_note: 2026-11-14 (experiments_ab.md section 10 item 7, before the freeze): + avatar_experiment.json (the avatar experiment's run-once guard) and gesture_geometry.json (the declared tolerance of the gesture geometry check); looks_ab.json (the anime variants), look_check.json (PROCEED posed swing), look_check_play_ab.json (PROCEED, the variants, Boxo v2's exclusion) and worker_v4.json were already listed (worker_v4.json unchanged; the arm scaling is code, pinned by the commit). 24 files. B9 OF THE NEW STUDY (2026-11-14, experiments_ab.md section 7 step 4, Nusrat; pending Anisha's freeze): the v4 scene and its configs as before, plus what the experiments read at Play (looks_ab.json, experiments_ab_unity.json, the left-turn map roadmap_proposals/turn_left.json), the avatar experiment's look-check configs (look_check.json, look_check_play_ab.json; section 8) and the nine final experiment configs sessions/final_ab_<setting>.json. The four superseded Task 2 session configs left the list (never run). Python's experiment files (scenarios_ab.json, the control and map files of configs/v4/experiments/) are Anisha's freeze. Earlier note: B9 (AUDIT.md section 14.7, Nusrat): the Unity files of the v4 scene to freeze, as repository paths. Anisha adds them to configs/v4/frozen.json the way the v3 Unity files were added; a final is refused unless every file is recorded there (looked up by this path in any of its hash tables) with its LF-normalised SHA-256. Code is pinned by the commit in session.json. The avatar look assets are third-party and not in git, so they are not hashed; each session records their appearance text.
